subject: QBR prep: roadmap alignment + launch guardrails
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: roadmap alignment + launch guardrails

Team —

QBR is two weeks out. I need a compact, actionable snapshot of product + engineering status for the exec pack. Please do the following by EOD Friday 2027-06-12: 

- One slide (or one page) per initiative we plan to call out in the QBR. Include current ETA, single biggest delivery risk (P1/P2/P3), owner, and a one-line mitigation.
- An updated launch timeline (milestones + gating criteria) for any launches between now and end of Q3.
- Call out any cross-org blockers (security, procurement, infra) and who we need to pull in.

Primary asks we must answer in the QBR: launch readiness windows, expected latency/cost delta for suggested quantization profiles, and a fallback plan if a new kernel path causes regressions.

I've attached a brief roadmap_summary_v2.pdf and a starter launch_risk_matrix.xlsx. We'll sync as a leadership group on Tue 2027-06-15 10:00 PT — please hold that time; if you can't make it, send your slide.

Thanks — be concise; executives want risks + ask, not long narratives.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap alignment + launch guardrails

Neha —

Quick runtime status update (one slide will follow):

- Serving runtime (v2.3): ETA to beta is 2027-07-20 (slip from 7/10 due to kernel refactor).
- Primary risk (P1): vendor kernel integration tests are failing at high sequence lengths (memory spill).
  - Mitigation: we have a fallback kernel path that avoids the new optimization; patch ETA 6/28.
- Secondary risk (P2): CI perf regressions on longer sequences — we can gate the optimization behind a flag and roll out to 25% first.
- Dependency: require procurement approval for additional GPUs for extended perf testing (ticket raised).

I'll attach runtime_timeline.xlsx in the slide pack. If the vendor fix slips beyond 6/28 we should plan a constrained feature rollout (shorter sequence cap) rather than block the full release.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Eng Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap alignment + launch guardrails

Neha / Marcus —

Product notes for the exec slide: 

- Customer acceptance risk (P1): quantized model outputs show a small but consistent drop in copy-generation NLU scores for domain X in our internal evals (quant 4-bit). We need a short A/B test plan (two-week gated rollout) and a rollback criterion.
- UX gating: we should not expose the new kernel path to enterprise customers before a 30% opt-in pilot; recommend we include the pilot cohort in the QBR ask.
- Business ask: if perf varies >20% at p99 in Canary, we fall back to current model (guardrail).

I've compiled a short blocker list and attached product_blocker_log.csv to the slide pack. Tessa, can you map the blockers to support/CS owners so we can include action owners in the QBR?

Thanks — I'll prepare the product slide tonight.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Product, Serving Platforms
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap alignment + launch guardrails

Thanks for the updates. A couple of executive-level requests to make the QBR actionable: 

1) SLA & escalation guardrail: provide a concrete fallback configuration (model variant + route policy) that will be auto-switched if p99 latency crosses our SLA threshold. Include estimated cost delta for that fallback (per-1M tokens).

2) One-pager for execs: a single-page summary that lists (a) initiatives called out, (b) the binary ask we will present (go/no-go / sign-off needed), and (c) immediate risks with who to call if things regress. Need this by Tue 6/15 3:00 PM PT.

3) Procurement risk: if additional test capacity (GPUs) is required, please flag expected lead times — we cannot assume immediate provisioning. Marcus, coordinate with procurement contact at CloudVendor (procure@cloudvendor.com).

4) Guardrails checklist: include rollout percentage caps, telemetry checks that must pass pre-commit, and automatic rollback triggers. Tessa — can you draft a short checklist for the QBR slide?

Keep it tight. I'll bring the one-pager to the exec sync.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Ward <sophie.ward@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap alignment + launch guardrails

Team — consolidating action items and owners (per Vivek's ask):

- Exec one-pager (Neha) — draft attached (QBR_onepager_draft.pdf). Deadline: Tue 6/15 3:00 PM PT (Vivek asked for final copy; I will circulate final by EOD).
- Fallback plan (Marcus + Laura) — define model variant + routing policy + cost delta. Deliverable: one slide + numeric cost estimate. Due: Mon 6/14 12:00 PT (Marcus to confirm).
- Pilot rollout plan & rollback criteria (Laura) — include A/B metrics and acceptance thresholds. Deliverable: product slide + acceptance rubric. Due: Fri 6/18 5:00 PT.
- Procurement capacity note (Marcus) — expected lead time for extra GPUs from CloudVendor. Marcus will coordinate with procure@cloudvendor.com and report ETA by 6/16.
- Guardrails checklist (Tessa) — short, actionable checklist for rollout triggers/telemetry/rollback. Deliverable: launch_guardrails.md. Due: Mon 6/14 10:00 PT.

External note: Sophie (Acme) — we may need to schedule a brief pilot kickoff for enterprise customers; Laura will reach out with proposed cohort details.

I'll consolidate slides and send the final exec pack by 6/15 18:00 PT. If anyone expects slippage, call it out now so we can adjust the exec ask.

Thanks — concise and pragmatic.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
Attachments: QBR_onepager_draft.pdf (attachment stub), launch_guardrails.md (attachment stub)
